newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish parties rating in CBOS opinion poll.
newsitem.headline: Polish parties rating in CBOS opinion poll.

text.p: Polish political parties' ranking according to the February poll by the public CBOS agency. Parliamentary elections are due around September, 1997.

The CBOS poll was carried out between February 14 and 17 among a representative group of the 64 percent of adults which declared plans to vote in the elections. Its error margin was 3.2 percent. AWS - an opposition electoral bloc of more than 30 small right-wing parties led by the Solidarity trade union. SLD - the ex-communist group, the larger partner in the ruling leftist coalition. PSL - the smaller partner in the government coalition UW - a right-centrist group, the biggest opposition party in parliament. ROP - a non-parliamentary group, advocating patriotic, anti-communist and often populist values. UP - leftist opposition party.
